title: Parametric Trajectory Distillation for Few-Step Video Generation
title_zh: 用于少步视频生成的参数化轨迹蒸馏

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种参数化轨迹蒸馏方法（PTD），以提高Few-Step视频生成的效率和质量。 Video diffusion and flow models require many sequential evaluations, making generation computationally expensive. Few-step distillation reduces this cost but poses a capacity allocation problem: a student must match the teacher's iterative generation with far less sequential computation. Existing trajectory methods ask the student to reproduce teacher transitions that are highly curved at high noise, which can exceed its capacity and degrade fine detail. We introduce Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD), which lets the student parameterize teacher trajectory segments as polynomials and learn from teacher guidance along its own predicted path. PTD is designed to let the learned curvature adapt to the backbone's predictive capacity, preserving motion and diversity. The curvature head is used only in training; inference keeps the original backbone architecture. On Wan2.1-14B, four-step PTD sets a new state of the art for trajectory distillation, significantly improving dynamic quality and naturalness over PDD, the best-performing trajectory-only method on this model, under the same training setting. On the 33B audio-video MiniMax-H3, LoRA-trained PTD significantly improves diversity and naturalness over the state-of-the-art LightX2V Turbo. Blinded human votes give PTD 55.1% and 63.4% preference shares against PDD and LightX2V Turbo. Project page: https://alan-lanfeng.github.io/PTD/.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种参数化轨迹蒸馏方法（PTD），以提高Few-Step视频生成的效率和质量。视频扩散和流模型需要大量的序列评估，导致生成过程计算成本高昂。 Few-step蒸馏虽然降低了这一成本，但也带来了容量分配问题：学生模型必须用远少于教师模型的序列计算能力，来匹配其迭代生成过程。 现有的轨迹方法要求学生模型复现教师在高噪声阶段高度弯曲的过渡过程，这可能会超出其容量限制，并导致细节退化。 我们提出了参数化轨迹蒸馏（PTD），该方法允许学生模型将教师轨迹片段参数化为多项式，并沿着自身预测的路径从教师的指导中学习。 PTD的设计旨在让学习到的曲率能够自适应于主干网络的预测能力，从而保留运动动态和多样性。 曲率头仅在训练阶段使用；推理阶段则保留原始的主干网络架构。 在Wan2.1-14B上，四步PTD为轨迹蒸馏树立了新的SOTA，与同一模型下表现最佳的纯轨迹方法PDD相比，在相同训练设置中显著提升了动态质量和自然度。 在33B音频视频模型MiniMax-H3上，通过LoRA训练的PTD相较于当前最先进的LightX2V Turbo，显著提升了多样性和自然度。 在盲测中，人类投票结果显示，与PDD和LightX2V Turbo相比，PTD的偏好率分别达到了55.1%和63.4%。 项目页面：https://alan-lanfeng.github.io/PTD/。
